notes: Increment public release numbers by 0.1: 1.0 through 1.9, then 2.0 through 2.8.
Existing original tags remain unchanged; new two-component tags avoid collisions.
Historical binaries retain their original embedded build versions; new history numbers and original build identities are documented.
The two tag-only versions have source archives but no release executables to mirror.
Changing release-associated tags changes canonical release/download paths; maintain an old-to-new link index.

Installed 3.0.0-alpha clients need a one-time installer migration to 2.8 because their old version comparator rejects a numerically lower release. The legacy stable 2.0.2 comparator was checked and accepts 2.8 as newer.
GitHub displays releases newest-first; the complete repository history document will be ascending.
